Name: Piano Valley for Content Patcher
Author: luxiferxx
Description:
Hello! Thanks so much for downloading my Content Patcher content pack mod.

Go to the video tab to see a showcase of some of the beautiful music featured!

⊱ ──────────{.⋅ ♫ ⋅.}────────── ⊰

In this mod, these music files are replaced:

[list]
[*]MainTheme
[*]libraryTheme
[*]Saloon1
[*]springtown
[*]spring1
[*]spring2
[*]spring3
[*]summer1
[*]summer2
[*]summer3
[*]fall1
[*]fall2
[*]fall3
[*]winter1
[*]winter2
[*]winter3
[*]grandpas_theme
[*]MarlonsTheme
[*]marnieShop
[*]distantBanjo
[*]christmasTheme
[*]SettlingIn
[*]CloudCountry
[*]rain
[*]50s
[*]wavy
[*]woodsTheme
[*]title_night
[/list](more to come when I obtain permissions to use more music)

[size=3][b][u]...with beautiful, calming piano covers from THESE AMAZING ARTISTS:[/u][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/c/pallypiano]팰리 Pally[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoWzqxRSLcIgEVDq2iLx5gQ]PAldousMusic[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCDj1R4f_3IyaJxiG4PYH9w]Naru's Composition 작곡가 나루[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.fiverr.com/wrmusic]wrmusic[/url]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N0vCrlPHdTs]3HeadedMonke[/url]
[*][url=https://www.fiverr.com/olivervwhite]Oliver White[/url]﻿

[/list](more to come when I obtain permissions to use more music)

[b]PLEASE CHECK OUT THEIR CHANNELS AND THEIR MUSIC![/b] They are all extremely talented and this mod wouldn't exist without them!



Here is the [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOHOucMYzk5-L9SfR3FfluhoNe7JltbY0]YouTube playlist[/url] with all the song covers I [s](intend to)[/s] use in this mod.

Just plop the file "[CP] Piano Valley" that I provide in your "Mod" file and it should work. This mod requires you to have SMAPI and the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed.


Some converted .wav files provided by realhokum!

Some converted converted .ogg files provided by nightowl2012!

Content Patcher conversion provided by lunamaenova!
